card.name: Auxiliary verbs before an expected negative
card.fires_on: Small helper words such as be, been, is, were, do and 've, placed where a negation (not, no, never) or a negative-leaning phrase is likely to come next. Seen in drug-label warnings and general web text.

modes.description: A helper verb (is, were, do, be) is followed directly by not or no.
